t: Din kamma tzarik ledaqdeq ulekavven biqriat shema
s: Din kamma tzarik ledaqdeq ulekavven biqriat shema ubo k"h seipim: lekattechilla tzarik lehizzaher veliqrot kol hag' parashiyyot shel qeriat shema bekavvana, beema ubeyira beretet ubezia, kederek shebbene hammedina qorin perutegma shemmeshagger lahem hammelek, dehaynu ketab hammelek al bene medinato, shehem omedim al raglehem veqorin otan beema ubeyira uberetet ubezia, uqeriat shema hi perutegma shel haqqadosh baruk hu leammo yisrael, velo hitriach alenu haqqadosh baruk hu liqrotah meummad, ella "belekteka badderek", ak tzarik al kol panim liqrotah beema ubeyira:

Vetzarik shettihyeh beenayv kiprutegma chadasha shello shemaah meolam. Vezehu sheamar hakkatub: "asher anoki metzavveka hayyom", kelomar bekol yom yihyu beeneka kachadashim, velo kemo shekkebar shama dabar echad harbeh peamim sheshshub eno chabib etzlo kebattechilla:

Biqriat shema yesh rm"h tebot vechaseru g' tebot lehashlim rm"ch keneged abarayv shel adam, shekkol haqqore qeriat shema ketiqqunah — kol eber notel teba achat umitrappe bah, laken nohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur chozer veomer "Hashem elohekem emet" beqol ram, ubazeh kol adam yotze, hoil veshomein mippiv shel sheliach tzibbur g' tebot ellu. Vekol hatztzibbur kesheqqorin leatzman belachash omerim "ani Hashem eloqekem emet", umamtinim al hashsheliach tzibbur, veachar kak matchilin "veyatztzib", veenan chozerin veomerin "emet", shekkol haomer "emet emet" beli hepseq teba acheret benetayim — keillu omer "shema shema", shemmashtiqin oto im lo shaha kelal benetayim kemo sheyyitbaer. Veap im shaha qetzat — en likpol lekattechilla beli hepseq teba acheret benetayim. Abal im rotzeh kol yachid lachazor im hashsheliach tzibbur "Hashem elohekem emet" — en issur baddabar, meachar shemmapsiq ben "emet" le"emet" betebat "Hashem elohekem". Vehashsheliach tzibbur yesh nohagin shello lomar "emet" kesheqqore belachash leatzmo, sheim yomar belachash "emet" vechozer veomer "emet" beqol ram — yihyeh rm"t tebot. Veyesh nohagin lomar "emet" gam belachash, shello lehaprid ben Hashem eloqekem le"emet", ve"emet" hashsheni eno min hamminyan ella nussach birkat "emet veyatztzib" hu:

Umi sheeno qore qeriat shema betzibbur — alayv neemar: "vechesron lo yukal lehimmanot", ellu g' tebot shechaseru lo mimminyan rm"ch. Veap al pi ken yesh lo qetzat taqqana, lekavven bet"v vavi"n shebbe"emet veyatztzib". Yesh meporshim kavvana zo shet"v vavi"n olin tz', vehen keneged g' shemot hvy"h shekkol echad oleh k"v ved' otiyyotayv hen l'. Veyesh meporshim shet"v vavi"n olin tz' veim haqqeria hare tz"a, keminyan hashshem biqriato ubiktibato, ukeillu amar "Hashem adn"y emet". Veyesh omerim taqqana acheret leqore beyachid, sheyyomar "el melek neeman" "shema vego'", veg' tebot ellu mashlimin minyan rm"ch, vehen bimqom amen sheyyesh laanot achar "habbocher beammo yisrael beahaba", ki amen rashe tebot "el melek neeman". Umikkol maqom kesheqqore betzibbur — lo yomar "el melek neeman", raq yomar amen achar hashsheliach tzibbur keshemmesayyem habberaka. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu:
Nohagin liqrot pasuq rishon beqol ram kede leorer hakkavvana. Venohagin litten yedehem al penehem biqriat pasuq rishon, kede shello yistakkel bedabar acher shemmoneo milkavven:

Kol hammaarik bdly"t shel "echad" — maarikin lo yamayv ushenotayv. Vegam lo yachatop bechay"t ella yaarik bah qetzat, kede sheyyamlik haqqadosh baruk hu bashshamayim ubaaretz, shez' reqiim vehaaretz keminyan chy"t. Ulezeh rimmez hachatoteret shebbeemtza haggag shel chy"t, kelomar chay hu berumo shel olam. Abal bedalay"t tzarik lehaarik yoter, kede shiur sheyyachshob shehaqqadosh baruk hu yachid beolamo umoshel bed' ruchot haolam, veen tzarik lehaarik yoter mikkeshiur zeh. Veyesh nohagin lehattot harosh kepi hammachashaba, mala vamatta uled' ruchot:

Tzarik lehadgish bedalay"t shello tihyeh karay"sh, velo sheyiqraena bedagesh shehare en bah dagesh, ella sheyatimena bappeh yapeh. Vekol shekken shello yapeh osim hammadgishin umaarikin yoter miday, venireh keillu had' nequda bishva"a. Umah sheameru lehaarik bed' shel echad — lo ameru lehaarik velimshok biqriat had', shehare kol ot shebbesop hatteba veen nequdda tachteha hi nechtepet legamre, ella yaarik bemachashabto lehamliko bed' ruchot biqriat had' veachareha beterem sheyyatchil "baruk shem". Veap mi sheeno maarik bed' shel echad — yesh lo lehapsiq meat ben "echad" le"baruk", ki iqqar qibbul malkut shamayim hu bepasuq rishon veyesh lo lehapsiq beno leben shear debarim:

Haomer "shema shema" — meshatteqin oto, mippene shennira kimqabbel alayv shette rashuyyot. Vehu sheomer kol happasuq vechozer veomero shenit, abal im kopel kol teba — megunneh hu abal en meshatteqin oto, sheen zeh domeh limqabbel alayv shette rashuyyot ella kemitlotzetz. Veyesh omerim lehepek, shekkeshekkopel kol teba — mashtiqin oto, ukesheomer kol happasuq veshoneh oto — en mashtiqin oto abal megunneh hu. Uledibre hakkol en mashtiqin oto ella kesheomer betzibbur ubeqol ram. Abal lekattechilla asur bekol inyan, apillu liqrot kol happarasha velachazor velishnotah miyyad, ella im ken kesheqqore qeriat shema al mittato, shemmuttar lo liqrot qeriat shema kamma peamim kede lehishtaqqea beshena mittok qeriat shema. Veyesh mi sheomer sheggam bazeh yesh lizzaher millomar pasuq rishon b' peamim. Verauy lachush lidbarayv. Abal mah sheyyesh nohagin lomar "shema" bekol paam sheomerim "vayyaabor" basselichot — en bazeh shum chashash, shekkevan shemmapsiq harbeh benetayim — lo nira kimqabbel b' rashuyyot:

Haomerim baashmoret basselichot ubeyom hakkippurim bitpillat neila b' peamim pasuq "shema yisrael" — yesh lelammedan shello yomru, shehare ledibre hakkol al kol panim megunneh hu, veyesh omerim gam ken shemmashtiqin:

"Hashem hu haeloqim" sheomerim bitpillat neila z' peamim — minhag kasher hu, shemmeshabbechim oto sheddar lemala miz' reqiim. Veen lachush bekopalto leb' rashuyyot, shehare matztzinu shehukpal bammiqra gabbe eliyyahu: "vayomru (kol haam) Hashem hu haeloqim vego'":

Yesh omerim sheyyesh lizzaher shello laanot "amen amen", mishshum b' rashuyyot. Veyesh omerim sheen chashash, shehare david amar "amen veamen", veen lechalleq ben omer beva"v leomer belo va"v. Veken iqqar:

Mah shennohagin lomar g' peamim "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" besiyyum tepillat neila — en lachush mishshum b' rashuyyot, shello chasheshu ella bi"shema yisrael" shehi iqqar qabbalat malkut shamayim, abal kesheameru "shema yisrael" paam achat — en lachush bikpilat "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" leb' rashuyyot, shehare onin oto al "Hashem echad" shebbi"shema yisrael":

Achar pasuq rishon tzarik lomar "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" bachashay, lepi shebbeshaa shebbiqqesh yaaqob legallot haqqetz lebanayv nistalleqa mimmennu shekina, amar: shemma yesh bakem echad sheeno hagun, patechu kullam veameru: "shema yisrael Hashem elohenu Hashem echad", kelomar shema mimmennu atta yisrael abinu, keshem sheen belibbeka ella echad — kak en belibbenu ella echad, miyyad patach hazzaqen veamar: "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed". Ameru chakamim: heak naaseh? Nomar "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" — lo ketabo mosheh battora, lo nomar — amaro yaaqob, hitqinu lomar bachashay. Veim lo ameru kol iqqar — machazirim oto:

Tzarik lehapsiq meat ben "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" li"veahabta" kede lehapsiq ben qabbalat malkut shamayim lishar mitzvot, ki "shema yisrael" u"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed" hu leshon qabbala, sheanachnu meqabbelim elohuto umalkuto, "veahabta" hu leshon tzavvaa. Veyesh lehapsiq bepasuq rishon ben "yisrael" le"h'" uben "elohenu" le"h'" hab', kede sheyyihyeh nishma: shema yisrael, ki Hashem shehu elohenu — hu Hashem echad:
Tzarik lehapsiq ben "hayyom" le"al lebabeka", uben "hayyom li"leahaba", shello yihyeh nireh "hayyom al lebabeka", velo lemachar:

Tzarik lehapsiq ben "nishba" le"h'", kede lehatim yapeh haayi"n shello tehe niret keHashem, ukeillu omer "nishba Hashem" chas veshalom. Tzarik lehattiz zyy"n shel "tizkeru" veshel "uzekartem", shello tidmeh qeriatah lesam"k, ki kol z' hassemuka lek"p shelleachareha doma qeriatah lesam"k im lo mattizin otah:
Tzarik lehadgish yv"d shel "shema yisrael", shello tibbala velo teraeh al"p ukeillu omer "asharal". Veken yu"d shel "vehayu", shello yihyeh nishma keillu omer "vahav":
Tzarik litten revach ben "vechara" le"ap", shello yihyeh nireh keillu omer "vecharap":

Tzarik litten revach ben teba sheot shebbitchillatah keot shebbesop teba shellepaneha, shello tibbala ot achat mehen, kegon: "al lebabeka", "al lebabkem", "vaabadtem mehera", "hakkanap petil", "etkem meeretz". Veken "bekol lebabeka", "bekol lebabkem". Ella shebbahen tzarik shello yapsiq harbeh, shehare yesh maqqap benetayim vetzarik lehasmikan. Veap al pi ken yitten revach vehebdel bel' sheyyihyeh nishma sheqqore b' lmdy"n:

Kol teba shettechillatah al"p vesop teba shellepaneha m"m — tzarik lehapsiq meat benehem, shello tibbala hal"p, kegon: "velimmadtem otam", "uqeshartem otam", "ureitem oto", "vesamtem et", "uzekartem et", "vaasitem et", shello yihyeh nireh keqore: "motam", "moto", "met":

Velo biqriat shema bilbad, ella ap bipsuqe dezimra ubattepilla tzarik ledaqdeq bekol zeh. Vehu haddin haqqore battora o bannebiim o bakketubim — yesh lo lizzaher bekol zeh. Umah shehizhiru biqriat shema, hu, mippene shekkol yisrael qorin otah paamayim bayyom, chakamim veamme haaretz, lepikak hutzreku lehazhir mippene amme haaretz sheenam beqiim biqria:

Tzarik lizzaher shello yadgish harapeh, velo yerappeh haddagesh, velo yaniach sheva"a hanna, velo yania sheva"a hannach. Veezeh sheva"a na veezeh sheva"a nach — yadua lehamdaqdeqim. Vekol diqduqim ellu hem lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"b:

Yesh mi sheomer shetztzarik liqrot qeriat shema bitamim kemo shehem battora. Verauy lachush lidbarayv. Abal lo nahagu ken bimdinot ellu, veqasheh leshannot hamminhag bazeh, ki haqqeria bitamim mapsedet hakkavvana lemi shello hurgal bah meodo lekavven bingina ubeperush hammillot karauy. Abal harotzeh lehachmir al atzmo veyodea sheyyukal lekavven bishtehen — yachmir, vetabo alayv beraka:

Minhag yapeh hu lemashmesh battepillin ubatztzitzit keshemmazkir mitzvatan biqriat shema, dehaynu sheyyemashmesh bitpillin shel yad kesheomer "uqeshartam leot" ku', ubitpillin shel rosh kesheomer "vehayu letotapot" ku', ukeshehu omer "ureitem oto" — yemashmesh beb' tzitzit shellepanayv veyistakkel bahen kemo shennitbaer besiman k"d:

Yesh nohagin liqrot qeriat shema beqol ram, millebad "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed". Veyesh nohagin liqrotah belachash, millebad pasuq rishon, mippene chashash shemma yibtach acher al hashshemia velo yiqra beatzmo, ubeemet eno yotze bishmia ella keshet' shomein meechad hamkavven lehotziam kemo shennitbaer besiman n"t:
